resume-buddy-faqs.title: Resume Buddy FAQs
resume-buddy-faqs.content:
FAQs

General Questions

What is Resume Buddy?

Resume Buddy , a product of QE&D is an AI-powered platform designed to analyze your resume against specific job descriptions (JD) and career goals. It provides instant, actionable feedback (Free Service) or generates a fully optimized, ATS-friendly resume file (Premium Service).

Does Resume Buddy offer job placement or act as a recruitment agency?

No. We do not offer jobs, nor are we a recruitment or staffing agency. Our entire focus is on equipping you with the best resume and career tools so you can successfully secure the job yourself using our services.

How does the AI work? Is it an Applicant Tracking System (ATS)?

Our AI simulates a modern Applicant Tracking System (ATS) scan but goes far beyond simple keyword matching. It analyzes structural compliance, keyword density, action verb usage, and measurable impact to ensure your resume is instantly shortlist-ready.

Do I get a refund ?

No refunds are applicable. Please read our Refund and Cancellation policy on the QE&D website.

General Questions

How long does the process take?

The delivery time varies by service:

  • Free Feedback: The email delivery usually takes about 2–3 minutes. Disclaimer: Delivery speed depends on current volume and your internet connection. If you experience a delay, please see the troubleshooting section below.

  • Premium Deliverables: These require AI generation and formatting. Delivery usually takes up to 30 minutes, but times can vary depending on the complexity of your resume correction needs, the target role, and the current platform volume. We appreciate your patience!

Can I use the Resume Buddy Free Service anytime?

Yes, absolutely! We encourage you to tailor your resume for every role you apply for. The quick feedback and tips you receive will guide you to success—think of Resume Buddy as your on-demand career coach.

Is Resume Buddy applicable for all industries and all experience levels?

Yes. The platform is built to analyze and optimize resumes across all industries and all career levels, from Freshers seeking entry-level roles to Experienced Professionals targeting executive positions.

Is my personal data and resume information kept private?

Yes. We treat your data with the highest level of confidentiality. Your resume and JD information are used solely for the purpose of generating your requested feedback and optimization deliverables. We may also share updates and offers of QE&D products. For more information please refer to the Privacy and Terms and Conditions  policies in the QE&D website.

Entry Fields Related Questions

Where do I find a relevant Job Description (JD)?

You can obtain a JD from several sources:

  1. Recruiters/Hiring Managers: Ask the person who contacted you for the specific JD.

  2. Job Platforms: Copy the JD directly from job sites like LinkedIn, Indeed, or Naukri.

  3. Google Search: Search for a JD relevant to the exact role and industry you are applying for.

What kind of resume file should I upload?

Always upload a text-based file (like a simple Word Document or plain text). Avoid heavily graphical resumes, PDFs, or image-heavy layouts, as these can confuse the initial text extraction needed for accurate analysis.

Why do I need to share the email id and phone number?

The Email id is mandatory and needs to be filled correctly. All your feedback and premium deliverables are directed to the email id entered in the form. 

Phone Numbers are mandatory and should be filled correctly. We need the phone number to call you for any troubleshooting issues you are facing. We can also share more information of out products and services and updates that can benefit you.

Name

Please enter your first name and last name in the respective field. No Special characters are allowed. Example John Doe. Single characters are not allowed too. Example J Smith. You need to enter the full legal name.

Field of Study (Freshers only)

DO NOT use special characters or full stops. Enter simple terms like: Commerce, Computer Science, BE, BTech, MBA.

Current Role vs Target Role

Current Role- Mention your current designation

Target Role-  Mention the designation you are applying for Example Sr. Operations Manager

Quality Role

Quality Role- Mention Yes if you are in the following roles - Transaction Quality, Continuous Improvement, Training and Quality.

Current Function

State the function simply, such as: Operations, Quality, Administration, Finance, Sales.

Error Related Questions

I received a "Resume Cannot Be Uploaded" or "Resume Not Found" error.

This error indicates the system could not properly read your file. The root cause is typically that the resume is not in a recognized text-based format. Please ensure you are uploading a proper text-based resume (like a simple DOCX file) and avoiding heavily formatted PDFs, images, or graphical layouts. If the issue persists, please contact us at info@quality-education.net.

I received a "Time Out" or "Empty String" error during submission.

  • These errors often occur due to high request volume or a temporary connection issue during submission. The safest way to proceed is to close the current window and submit a new form completely.

  • If the issue persists: Please try again later during an off-peak time, or contact us at info@quality-education.net for dedicated assistance.

I made a payment but have not received my premium deliverables.

First, please wait approximately 30-60 minutes, as premium generation can take time depending on volume. Second, confirm that the email ID you entered was correct, as otherwise, you won't receive the email. If the deliverables still haven't arrived after 60 minutes, please confirm the payment was a success and write to info@quality-education.net with your transaction details so we can track and send your file immediately.

Are group discounts or corporate training options available?

Yes! If you’re looking to enroll a team or a group, we offer group discounts and customized corporate training programs. Please contact us at info@quality-education.net for more details.

  3. Payment Processing:

    • When paying for a course , assessment or use any of our products such as Resume Buddy online, you will provide payment details (such as credit/debit card information, email, and phone number). This information is processed securely over an encrypted connection by our trusted payment service providers, which may include banks like IDFC, Razorpay, or any other authorized financial institution. We do not store your payment information; it is used solely to process transactions and issue refunds in accordance with our website’s terms and conditions.

  4. Cookies and Tracking:

    • We use cookies and similar technologies to track your interactions with our website and to improve user experience and service delivery. For further details, please refer to our Use of Cookies Statement.

Purposes for Processing and Disclosures

Your personal data is processed for the following purposes:

  • Service Delivery: To facilitate enrollment, provide access to courses and assessments, and support your learning journey.

  • Regulatory Compliance: To ensure compliance with Indian laws, including eligibility checks for government funding.

  • Communication: To respond to queries, deliver updates on course developments, and inform you about relevant offers—only when you have opted in.

  • Research and Improvement: For collecting anonymized statistical data to enhance our educational services.

  • Legal Obligations: To safeguard our legal rights and comply with regulatory or legal proceedings as required by Indian law.

Data Sharing:

  • With your consent or as required for service delivery, we may share certain personal data with awarding bodies, government agencies (including the Skills Funding Agency via their Learner Registration Service), and sponsors such as employers or trade organizations.

  • Authorized service providers and approved centers associated with our courses will have access to your essential details (e.g., name, date of birth, contact information, learner reference number) strictly for service provision and compliance purposes.

Security and Data Protection

We have implemented robust technical and organizational measures to ensure the security and integrity of your personal data. This includes:

  • Secure Servers: Your account and associated data are stored on secure servers with password protection, accessible only to a limited number of trained employees and authorized sub-contractors under strict confidentiality agreements.

  • Regular Backups: We perform regular backups and updates to our systems to prevent data loss and unauthorized access.

  • Encryption: Sensitive information transmitted online is encrypted using industry-standard protocols. However, please note that no online transmission can be guaranteed as completely secure, and you assume any associated risks.

Your Rights Under Indian Law

In accordance with Indian privacy guidelines, you have the right to:

  • Access: Request a copy of the personal data we hold about you (a nominal fee may apply).

  • Correction: Ask us to correct any inaccuracies in your personal data.

  • Restriction: Object to or restrict the processing of your personal data if it is likely to cause you unjustified harm or distress.

  • Withdrawal of Consent: Withdraw your consent at any time, which may affect our ability to provide certain services.

To exercise these rights or for further inquiries regarding our data processing practices, please contact us at +91 888 699 1370 or via email at info@quality-education.net.

Data Retention and Deletion

We retain your personal data only as long as necessary to fulfill the purposes for which it was collected, to comply with legal obligations, or to protect our legal rights. Records of deleted data (such as correspondence with tutors) may be kept for a reasonable period as part of your learning record.

Contact Information

For any questions regarding this Privacy Statement, to request access or corrections, or to address concerns about your personal data, please contact:

Quality Education and Deployment Pvt. Ltd.
Janapriya Nile Valley, Chandanagar, Hyderabad 500050
Phone: +91 888 699 1370

Promotional Activities

Quality Education and Deployment Pvt. Ltd. This information may be used to keep you informed about developments that might interest you. If you do not wish to receive these communications, you may opt out at any time by contacting us or adjusting your communication preferences through the Website.

certifying-your-skills.title: Certifying Your Skills
certifying-your-skills.content:
Certifying Your Skills

Certify Your Skills and Stand Out Professionally

QE&D’s Certifying Your Skills platform is designed for recent graduates, first-time job seekers, and working professionals who want to validate their capabilities through industry-recognized assessments. Our data-driven evaluations measure key employability skills and job-readiness based on global benchmarks — helping you earn a credible certification that strengthens your resume and improves your chances of getting interview calls.

Unlike traditional training programs, this is a pure assessment platform. We believe you already have the skills — and now it’s time to certify them. Please review our Eligibility Criteria before you begin. For personalized learning plans, visit our Courses section.

🔍 Recruiter-Driven Insights

Our PowerUp Skills (Employability Skills) Assessments are designed with recruiters in mind. They evaluate your real-world job-readiness using globally accepted frameworks such as NACE, SHRM, and 21st Century Skills. This recruiter-aligned approach ensures your results reflect the competencies most valued by employers — and that’s why 70–80% of hiring managers prefer candidates with certified soft skills.

Beyond employability, we offer specialized assessments like our Six Sigma Evaluation, created and validated by industry experts. Each test is rigorously benchmarked for accuracy, relevance, and global quality standards, ensuring your skills certification holds real weight in hiring decisions.

🌱 Pathway to Growth

At QE&D, we don’t just test — we give you actionable feedback. After each assessment, you’ll receive a detailed report outlining your strengths and areas for improvement. This helps you prepare confidently for interviews, communicate your skills with clarity, and pursue roles that align with your potential.

Please note, we do not offer job placements — but the lifetime-valid certificates you earn here demonstrate your abilities clearly to employers and HR professionals alike.

🚀 Getting Started

Registration on the Certifying Your Skills platform is completely free. Each assessment carries a small fee, payable only when you're ready to take the test.

To get started, simply fill out the "Request for Access" form or write to us at info@quality-education.net. Once approved, you’ll receive full access to the assessment dashboard.

[metform form_id="1167"]

✅ Key Benefits of the Certifying Your Skills Platform

  • Verified Credentials: Earn industry-recognized certificates that validate your real-world expertise and strengthen your resume.

  • Actionable Skill Reports: Get personalized feedback highlighting your strengths and key development areas — ideal for interview prep.

  • Continuous Improvement: Receive tailored growth recommendations to upskill effectively and stay competitive.

  • Interview Advantage: Stand out with recruiter-endorsed certifications that reflect the competencies employers value most.

  • Affordable & High-Value: Pay only for what you need — cost-effective assessments that offer measurable career ROI.

  • Relevant & In-Demand Skills: Assess yourself on skills aligned with today’s most sought-after job roles and business needs.

  • Flexibility & Convenience: Take assessments at your own pace with our user-friendly, question-based platform that helps you self-learn and improve.

🟢Why Choose Us

At QE&D, we believe in certifying skills that truly matter. Our assessments are built to international standards and validated by industry experts — not just to test knowledge, but to ensure job readiness.

  • High Standards, Real Confidence:
    We don’t believe in easy pass marks. Most of our certifications require a minimum 80% score to pass — giving both you and recruiters the confidence that you know your subject well.

  • Recruiter-Backed Assessments:
    Each test is designed from an employer’s lens, aligned with global frameworks like NACE, SHRM, and 21st Century Skills.

  • Expert Validation:
    All assessments are reviewed by industry professionals to ensure relevance, accuracy, and real-world applicability.

  • No Gimmicks. Just Credibility:
    We don’t offer training here — only certification. That means your success reflects your real skills, not our teaching.

faqs.title: FAQs
faqs.content:
FAQ

Have a question? Look here or Ask us!

We are passionate about quality education and we want to make it available to everyone who wants to improve their skills and career. 

What is QE&D?

Quality Education and Deployment Pvt Ltd (QE&D) is an ISO 29993:2017 certified organization with internationally accredited courses and frameworks. Founded in 2019, QE&D is dedicated to fostering the development of both individuals and companies.

QE&D has received many accolades such as Indian Achievers Award and many more. 

What types of courses do you offer?

At QE&D, we offer courses that boost personal growth and professional skills for fresh graduates, 1st time job seekers, quality analysts, emerging leaders, and ambitious professionals. Our programs deliver practical insights and hands-on learning, while our PowerUp Skills Training enhances employability for graduates and seasoned professionals. Plus, our "Certify Your Skills" tool helps you assess your strengths, improve areas of need, and prepare for interviews.

Who are these courses for?

Our courses are suitable for:

  • Professionals looking to advance their careers.
  • Beginners who want to develop new skills.
  • Students or fresh graduates seeking guidance.
  • Anyone looking for inspiration and practical learning.
How do I enroll in a course?

Enrolling is easy! Simply visit the Courses section, choose the course you’re interested in, and fill in your details. An executive from QE&D will reach out , counsel and explain the process of enrolling

Are the courses self-paced or live?

These courses are Live and includes interactive sessions, Q&A opportunities, and live coaching with instructors.

Check the course details for specifics.

Do I need prior experience or qualifications to take a course?

Most of our courses are beginner-friendly and require no prior experience. However, some advanced courses may have prerequisites, which will be clearly mentioned on the course page.

Are the courses and assessments certified by any international body?

QE&D is an ISO 29993:2017 certified organization that designs its training programs and assessments to meet international standards. Our courses undergo rigorous quality checks to ensure excellence. While inspired by international frameworks, our programs are independently developed and are not affiliated with any external governing bodies or subject to external approvals.

How long do I have access to the course content?

Once you enroll, you will have lifetime access to the course materials, including any future updates (unless otherwise stated).

Are there certificates provided upon course completion?

Yes, we provide a digital certificate of completion for every course. You can showcase it on your LinkedIn profile, resume, or share it with your network. These certificates have a lifetime validity.

What is your refund or cancellation policy?

There is no refund policy. The QE&D executive will guide you on the course details, collect the payment. Once the payment is made, it cannot be refunded. In case of date changes on commencement of training post making a payment, please write in to winston@quality-education.net and seek assistance.

Can I share my account or course materials with others?

No. Each enrollment is for individual use only. Sharing course content or account details violates our terms of service.

Does QE&D provide placements post completion of the courses?

No, QE&D does not offer placement assistance

How can I get in touch with the course instructors?

You can connect with instructors during live sessions or through the course discussion forum. 

How are your courses different from others?

Our courses stand out because they combine:

  • Real-world experience from professionals.
  • Inspirational insights to keep you motivated.

Practical tools and resources you can apply immediately.
We’re passionate about helping you grow and succeed.

Are group discounts or corporate training options available?

Yes! If you’re looking to enroll a team or a group, we offer group discounts and customized corporate training programs. Please contact us at info@quality-education.net for more details.

How do I give feedback or testimonials after completing a course?

We’d love to hear from you! You can leave feedback on our linkedin page. QE&D also collects feedback from all trainees via a feedback form post completion of the course.
